bio: Located on the outskirts of the town in a contemporary house that also serves as a hotel (with only four cosy rooms). The business is run by an attentive yet professional couple, with Tita taking care of everything in the dining room while Javier tends to the kitchen. You'll find a menu of traditional cuisine, with modern touches, as well as two set menus by reservation, a short one for weekday lunches (except summer) and a tasting menu called As Catedrais (a tribute to the famous natural beach, just over 6 miles away)....
